channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: Kalinga Lancers extend unbeaten run in Men’s Hero HIL
item.description: Shrachi Bengal Tigers kept their playoff hopes alive with a dramatic 3–2 comeback win against SG Pipers, while table-toppers Vedanta Kalinga Lancers maintained their unbeaten streak with a shootout victory over Accord Tamil Nadu Dragons.

item.title: PWL 2026: ​Manisha Bhanwala leads Maharashtra Kesari to its first win of the season
item.description: The Maharashtra team took a dominant 6-3 win over the Tiigers of Mumbai Dangals.

item.title: Tata Steel Chess Wijk Aan Zee: Praggnanandhaa faces a second consecutive defeat
item.description: Pragg lost to Uzbek GM Nodirbek Abdusattorov in round 2, following his first-round defeat to Arjun Erigaisi.

item.title: Indonesia Masters 2026: Indian shuttlers aim to bounce back after a dismal week - Preview
item.description: Indian shuttlers will be in action for the third consecutive week, heading to a Super500 after a forgettable home outing.

item.title: Former Italy striker Pamela Conti set to take charge of India U-17 Women’s Football Team
item.description: Former Italy striker and ex-Venezuela coach Pamela Conti is AIFF’s top choice to lead the India U-17 women’s team in the AFC U-17 Women’s Asian Cup 2026.

item.title: ISL clubs face stadium availability issues, forcing AIFF to juggle fixtures
item.description: Meanwhile, the AIFF has issued a Request for Proposal for broadcast rights for the upcoming season.

item.title: Ranchi Royals outlast HIL GC in 4–4 thriller, clinch shootout win in Men’s HIL
item.description: Ranchi Royals edged past HIL GC in a dramatic shootout after an eight-goal contest ended level in regulation time.

item.title: RCB storm into WPL playoffs after dominant 61-run win over Gujarat Giants
item.description: Royal Challengers Bengaluru sealed a playoff berth with a fifth straight victory, overpowering Gujarat Giants with a comprehensive all-round display.

item.title: PWL 2026: UP Dominators stun Delhi Dangal Warriors
item.description: Script dramatic comeback from 1-4 down to win 5-4 on Day 5.

item.title: Tata Steel Chess Wijk aan Zee: Arjun Erigaisi draws with Gukesh in round-3
item.description: Arjun remains in a joint lead alongside 4 other players, with 2/3 points.
